task: Determine whether retry or concurrency can duplicate the external side effect.
provenance: Synthetic SecHelix fixture using a local provider abstraction.

clean.source:
def charge(request, provider, db):
    with db.idempotency_lock(request.id) as claim:
        if claim.completed:
            return claim.result
        result = provider.charge(request.amount, idempotency_key=request.id)
        claim.complete(result)
        return result
